CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2016 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2016 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 868 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 3 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2016 to June 2016). These surveys captured 144 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 9 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 829 cards across 68 sites, with 13% showing evidence of mouse activity (108 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 248 transects across 57 sites (survey period: June 2016 to August 2016), detecting active burrows in 7.3% of transects (total: 32 active burrows).
